'''EchoBaseTrooper Royally beat the opponent with BHBM''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[EchoBaseTrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 28 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 BHBM EchoBaseTrooper DS 2003 Royallyb.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

BHBM deck made to win battles

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Basic Strategy:
Pull Rendili(cause you can retrieve Dominator). First turn deploy Palpy from reserve, pull Emperor's Power, deploy it, pull DSII:DB, deploy it. Also deploy Rendili. On following turns, deploy dbs, get Vader, put him at a docking bay, get Royal Guards with force pikes to invade their place(Myn Kyneugh + Kir Kanos w/force pikes is pretty good...)

Win battles so that if you lose the duel to Luke, you win the game right there. It's pretty self explanatory...
